zero_regression.description: Materials without packaging work exactly as before. No changes to existing behavior for simple materials.

bug1_fix.description: Cost conversion when receiving per package now works correctly. Previously, receiving 1 pack @ Rp144,000 would store unit_cost=144000 per pcs (causing value to balloon to 20.7M). Now correctly divides by pack_size to get unit_cost=1000 per pcs.
test_cases: Test Case A: input_unit='pack', cost_unit defaults to 'pack' → unit_cost=1000 ✓
Test Case B: input_unit='pack', cost_unit='pack' explicit → unit_cost=1000 ✓
Test Case C: input_unit='base', cost NOT divided → unit_cost=1000 ✓
Test Case D: total_cost provided → unit_cost=1000 ✓

multi_uom_3_level.description: 3-level UOM hierarchy (base -> pack -> carton) works correctly with proper validation.
test_cases: Create material with uoms: pcs(1) -> bks(144) -> ktn(1728)
Validation rejects: factor=0, >3 UOMs, duplicate codes, base factor != 1

partial_patch.description: Partial PATCH (updating only name) preserves UOM structure completely.
test_cases: Verify: UOM count preserved, pack_size=144 preserved

opname_conversion.description: Most dangerous case: opname counting per package now converts correctly to base unit.
test_cases: Count 3 packs with counted_uom='bks' → recorded as 432 pcs (3×144) ✓
Count 500 without counted_uom → recorded as 500 pcs (backward compat) ✓
opname_conversion.critical_note: This prevents the bug where counting '3 packs' would be recorded as '3 pcs', causing massive stock discrepancies.

material_issue.description: Material issue with UOM conversion works correctly.
test_cases: Issue 2 packs with input_unit='pack' → deducts 288 pcs (2×144)
